CRML.physical_anchor: Rare-earth (Tanbreez, Greenland) and lithium (Wolfsberg, Austria) mineral deposits it is permitting and developing toward extraction
CRML.value_chain_position: Pre-production developer of the Tanbreez REE-zirconium deposit and Wolfsberg lithium project; negligible current ore/concentrate sales

CTGO.physical_anchor: Gold doré/concentrate produced at the Manh Choh mine (Tetlin, Alaska), toll-processed via the Kinross-operated JV
CTGO.value_chain_position: Non-operating 30% JV partner receiving gold production cash flow from the Manh Choh mine, ore trucked to Kinross's Fort Knox mill

DC.physical_anchor: Gold ore at the Richmond Hill and Maitland deposits in the historic Homestake District, South Dakota, pre-construction

ECVT.physical_anchor: Regenerated sulfuric acid and silica-based catalysts it manufactures for refining, polyethylene and emission-control customers
ECVT.value_chain_position: Specialty-chemicals/catalyst manufacturer selling into refining and petrochemical customers - not a mining or metals company

EMN.physical_anchor: Specialty plastics, acetate tow and chemical intermediates it manufactures from petrochemical feedstocks

ESI.physical_anchor: Specialty chemicals (solder alloys, plating chemistries, electronic-assembly materials) it formulates for electronics and industrial customers
ESI.value_chain_position: Electronics/industrial specialty-chemicals formulator - not a miner or metal producer

EU.physical_anchor: Uranium extracted via in-situ recovery wellfields at Alta Mesa and Rosita, South Texas
EU.value_chain_position: ISR uranium producer with active South Texas wellfields selling U3O8 under term/spot contracts

FUL.physical_anchor: Industrial adhesives, sealants and specialty chemical formulations it manufactures for packaging, construction and durable-goods customers
FUL.value_chain_position: Global adhesives/specialty-chemicals manufacturer - not a miner or metals producer

GAU.physical_anchor: Gold ore mined and processed (CIL) at the Asanko Gold Mine, Ghana

GEVO.physical_anchor: Renewable isobutanol and sustainable aviation fuel it produces from corn/biomass feedstock
GEVO.value_chain_position: Renewable-fuels producer (SAF, isobutanol) on the agricultural/biofuel chain - not mining or metals

IAUX.physical_anchor: Gold-silver ore mined and processed at Ruby Hill, Granite Creek and McCoy-Cove, Nevada
IAUX.value_chain_position: Multi-mine Nevada gold-silver producer/developer with active production plus growth projects funded by production cash flow

IDR.physical_anchor: Gold ore mined and milled at the Golden Chest mine, Idaho, alongside a rare-earth-bearing (monazite) tailings stockpile

IE.physical_anchor: Copper (and gold/nickel) mineralization at the Santa Cruz project, Arizona, drilled using its Typhoon geophysical technology
